summary: At recorded step 152, the containers case has no usable floor container and enters pickup.c dotip()'s inventory path. The JavaScript dotip() currently throws before getobj() reads the queued p selection. C tip_ok() accepts the carried source bag, tipcontainer_gettarget() then accepts the queued q destination bag, and tipcontainer() transfers the source's three ordinary contents into that carried destination and updates both container weights and inventory. The missing targetbox arm is the continuation after the first stop; it is currently an explicit UnsupportedPickupError in js/pickup.js.

source.branch: When #tip is issued with no eligible floor container (the recorded state at step 152), dotip() calls getobj(); tip_ok() suggests carried containers and a discovered horn, downplays other non-coin inventory objects, and excludes coins. For this recording, p selects a carried bag, q selects the preselected destination-menu's other carried bag, and tipcontainer() takes the ordinary targetbox branch. The normal case must preserve the source checks, the "Objects tumble into the bag." message, per-object extraction and add_to_container(), then source/destination weight and inventory refresh; magic-bag explosion and cursed-bag branches remain source dependencies of the same family.

[pq or ?*]"; step 153 answers p and C opens "Where to tip the contents of a bag containing 3 items", then step 154 answers q and C emits "Objects tumble into the bag.".

The exact C owner is nethack-c/upstream/src/pickup.c:3481-3497 (tip_ok), 3505-3557 (choose_tip_container_menu), and 3562-3677 (dotip). dotip() calls getobj("tip", tip_ok, GETOBJ_PROMPT) at 3624, dispatches containers to tipcontainer() at 3628-3631, and includes the required spillage/potion/helmet/statue fall-through arms through 3677.

The C continuation is nethack-c/upstream/src/pickup.c:3688-3841: tipcontainer() calls tipcontainer_gettarget(), validates source and target, emits the targetbox tumble header at 3748-3751, then calls add_to_container(targetbox, otmp) at 3805 for each detached source object and refreshes weights/encumbrance at 3832-3841.

Current JS proves the missing scope: js/pickup.js:3637-3692 ports only the floor-container portion of dotip() and throws "dotip: inventory tipping path (getobj -> tip_ok)"; js/pickup.js:3492-3497 separately throws for any non-null targetbox, so fixing only the first stop cannot match steps 153-154.

Current JS production wiring already reaches the owner: js/cmd.js:4679 queues dotip for MCMD_TIP, js/cmd.js:5229-5231 dispatches the extended command, and js/iactions.js:336-340 queues dotip plus the selected inventory letter. No caller rewrite is needed for this case; the source work is the pickup.c family and its missing targetbox branch.

Prior GOALS evidence is explicitly bounded: GOALS.json goal tip is closed with dotip-single-container-quit and dotip-tipcontainer-floor-spill slices. Commit 6ed30803 records that inventory getobj/tip_ok and choose_tip_container_menu remained unported; commit 227785625 records that the floor-spill slice ported tipcontainer(), tipcontainer_gettarget(), and tipcontainer_checks() without exercising the y path. The current synthetic case is the first recorded inventory/targetbox continuation beyond that evidence.

Source-to-JavaScript dependency check: add_to_container() already enforces OBJ_FREE and merges in js/invent.js:4981-5005, while js/pickup.js tipcontainer() currently extracts objects before throwing at the targetbox guard. The implementation must preserve that C ownership order and either port pickup.c mbag_explodes()/do_boh_explosion() or retain an explicit named blocker for their return-dependent explosion branches; it must not invent RNG for the ordinary ration/potion/scroll transfer witnessed here.
